composition: Doric Temple of Segesta on the hillside · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands below the Doric Temple of Segesta on its lonely hillside, looking up at the full colonnade. The honey-colored stone columns run the length of the frame from the left, the pediment and entablature crisp against the sky, while the rolling Sicilian hills fall away to the right. The modelled 23 September 2026, 09:30 sun lights the temple's flank warmly, and scrub and wild grass cover the rocky slope at its feet.
